title: symphytum davisii subsp. naxicola
intro: Symphytum davisii subsp. naxicola, commonly known as "Naxian Comfrey", is a plant species belonging to the borage family (Boraginaceae) and is native to Greece. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including the promotion of wound healing, reduction of inflammation, and soothing of digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Naxian Comfrey are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its wound-healing and tissue-regenerating effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been identified in the plant's leaves and flowers.
